info.name: FDW Reference API
info.description:
Full RBAC integration tests: every endpoint x 5 auth levels (noauth->401, noperms->403, viewer, operator, admin) + invalid->400 + notfound->404. NFL data via GET /datasets/{Name}/query.

Auth: OpenIddict password-grant (POST /connect/token, form-encoded). RS256 JWT access tokens. Refresh via grant_type=refresh_token.
Preview slot: {{baseUrl}} = https://api-mt.preview.cyberdynedevelopment.dev/api/v1
